Website information

Terms of Use

Last updated: October 24, 2026

PDFEasy offers free browser-based PDF merging, splitting, page rotation, organization, and JPG/PNG image-to-PDF conversion. By using the tool, you agree to use it responsibly and only with documents you have a right to process.

Permitted use

Use the website for lawful personal, educational, or business document organization. Do not attempt to damage the service, exploit security weaknesses, or interfere with other users.

PDF compatibility

Merge PDF accepts up to 20 PDFs, 30 MB each and 100 MB total. Split, Rotate, and Organize accept one PDF of up to 50 MB; Organize supports up to 150 pages. JPG to PDF accepts up to 30 JPG/PNG images, 20 MB each and 120 MB in total. PDF files must be unlocked and supported. Editing or copying PDF pages may invalidate digital signatures or change forms, annotations, and metadata.

Check your output

You are responsible for reviewing the resulting PDF for completeness, order, formatting, and suitability before relying on it. For contracts or records requiring valid digital signatures, use a workflow appropriate to those documents.

Service availability

The site is provided on an as-available basis. Browser behavior, device memory, and file complexity can affect performance. Features may change as this project evolves.

Contact

For comments or corrections about these terms, see the Contact page. Website terms should be reviewed for accuracy and for the applicable jurisdiction before commercial launch.

Practical PDF tools built independently by a freelance developer. No account required. Your documents are processed in your browser.
